headline: A real iOS bundle from a custom SwiftPM product
summary: The app target was compiled into SwiftPM's aggregate archive, then a product-builder plug-in packaged that archive and this resource bundle into an iOS application.

features.title: Typed manifest model
features.detail: Composable Codable values become the builder's JSON payload.

features.title: Product-builder plug-in
features.detail: The plug-in plans work after SwiftPM has built targets and resources.

features.title: Xcode archive and IPA
features.detail: The host packager creates Info.plist, assets, entitlements, archive, and export artifacts.
